{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the number of unique patients
n_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {n_patients}')

# Confirm that no patient_id appears more than once now
assert df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique() == len(df_dedup), 'Duplicate patient_id after deduplication found'

# Verify that the deduplication worked as expected
print(f'Original row count: {len(df)}')
print(f'Deduplicated row count: {len(df_dedup)}')
print(f'Number of re-tested patients: {len(df) - len(df_dedup)}')"}
